inputs: Three deterministic 3D nodes generated by Python random.Random(seed); mass 1e5..2e5 kg, velocity ±100 m/s, distinct baseline positions (0,0,0), (1e6,0,0), (0,2e6,0) m; information 1..3 bits; Lyapunov 0..0.1/s; chaos energy 0 J.
arms: original CST helper equation (locally transcribed, no web3 runtime required)
success_criteria: The corrected candidate is finite at baseline; individual terms have compatible joule units by construction; Newton reduction and pair symmetry hold; legacy dominance and float64 lost-information are recorded without forced rescaling.
failure_criteria: A nonfinite or silently clipped corrected output, failed permutation invariance, nondeterminism, changing legacy API, claimed external prediction without independently measured outcomes, or missing raw inputs invalidates the corresponding claim.
scope: Synthetic arithmetic consistency and controls only. No physical validation, dynamic-force derivation, quantum results, or empirical prediction.
